description: Check a new supplier before onboarding or paying it, in one call: EU VAT validity (VIES), EU EORI validity, company identification (GLEIF, Norway registry) and sanctions + US export-control screening (OFAC, EU, UK, US CSL). Returns per-check status and sources, a screening_signal (not a compliance approval) and review_required. If a source fails: 503, not charged. Use when onboarding or paying a new supplier. $0.25 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

vat.description: EU VAT number with country prefix

name: supplier_check
